publication boundaries

Local pDAI-to-PLS exit evidence and publication boundaries
29 September 2026. Point 12 of the strengthened research: evidence boundaries, local exit observations
and reproducibility. This study interprets existing transactions and performs fixed-block public reads. No
transaction, governance action, state override or simulated state change was submitted.
Here, redemption means exchanging pDAI for PLS on PulseChain. It does not mean bridging out,
redeeming an issuer-supported Ethereum stablecoin, or receiving external dollars. Source-bridge return
rights remain relevant to claims about source backing, but are not a prerequisite for an ordinary funded
local swap.
Finding
An exact local pDAI/WPLS pool and a successful historical pDAI-to-WPLS exchange are now identified.
The larger transaction subsequently unwraps its combined WPLS proceeds into native PLS and pays the
initiating wallet. This substantiates an actual local exit component, rather than only an illustrative AMM
model.
The identified pDAI branch sells 782.592868262568217956 pDAI for 
264,588.142395152594479041 WPLS. Its output joins proceeds from other branches; the
transaction's larger native PLS payout must not be attributed solely to that pDAI input. No external PLS
dollar reference was collected, so this observation establishes neither a one-dollar execution value nor
future price support.
Provenance and fixed endpoint
The transaction was first found as a lead in the already saved explorer wallet list artifacts/parb-core-
addresses-20260929/address_reads.json. Its calldata alone was not taken as execution evidence. This batch
retrieved its receipt, historical trace and block, then reconciled actual token/native movements.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 284

Item Exact identity
Chain PulseChain, chain ID 369
Copied DAI 0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f
Wrapped native PLS 0xa1077a294dde1b09bb078844df40758a5d0f9a27
Observed pDAI/WPLS pool 0x947b4633e32e0c7f2c76753b43f008480715416d
Pool's endpoint factory getter 0x1715a3e4a142d8b698131108995174f37aeba10d
Historical transaction 0x520d978fba0438d37ac9048f0188bbb9174115f7f2a9abe103fa
b216a5e0d8ff
Historical block / UTC 22,524,531 / 23 January 2025, 18:49:45
Historical block hash 0x577eb850f3d8bb79385b60b3ef7b9ab487db2d71f3cb36b3ac9e
4ec055c81fbe
Sender / final native recipient 0x6e3bf3c7bd91144d694621298cb8da370479a7bb
Principal audit endpoint 27,659,393, 28 September 2026
Endpoint block hash 0xc5e582cd902f4bff3b1aa325b9b564fcd5d6dc0ffa77a03fcd10
5b65c6390275
Primary references are the historical transaction, pool and WPLS contract. Saved RPC request/response
records supply the fixed-block and historical detail; explorer pages are not substituted for them.
What actually moved
Within the larger aggregated trade, the execution contract 0x258e0bc6ed656ccb5147383dc02edeab141b6a9a
receives pDAI from a preceding branch and transfers exactly 782.592868262568217956 pDAI to the
identified pool. The pool transfers 264,588.142395152594479041 WPLS back to that execution contract.
Its Swap event reports the same amounts. Historical pool-reserve reads at the preceding block and the
transaction block reconcile exactly with this pDAI increase and WPLS decrease.
Observed quantity Amount
This branch's pDAI paid into pool 782.592868262568217956
This branch's WPLS output 264,588.142395152594479041
Branch gross WPLS per pDAI Approximately 338.091686144
Combined WPLS unwrapped across all branches 500,058.645141336259878379
Native PLS paid to initiating wallet 500,032.149752620780691584
Difference paid elsewhere by the execution contract 26.495388715479186795 PLS
Whole transaction's gas cost 2,391.582282068822951736 PLS
The successful historical trace contains WPLS.withdraw, the corresponding native payment from WPLS to
the execution contract, and subsequent native payment through 0x6bf228eb7f8ad948d37ded07e595efddfaaf88a6
to the initiating wallet. No failed frame was returned. The transaction's outer native value is zero. The
whole transaction's payout less its gas cost is 497,640.567470551957739848 PLS. That is neither
pDAI-branch profit nor the net PLS return attributable solely to its pDAI input: other assets
supplied other branches, and branch-specific cost allocation was not established.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 285

The pool's published PulseXPair source enforces an adjusted-balance invariant with 10000 and an input
deduction of 29, corresponding to a 0.29% swap fee in that mechanism. This explains why a reserve ratio
is not an execution quote. The recorded branch output already reflects its actual pool execution; no
hypothetical fee-free output is substituted for it.
A second saved wallet lead was checked as a direction control: transaction 0x05e0797a…. It includes
WPLS-to-pDAI movements and subsequent routing, with no native PLS payment in its returned trace. It is
not counted as another pDAI-to-PLS exit merely because both token addresses occur in its calldata.
WPLS is a local native wrapper
The verified WPLS source response identifies contract WPLS, symbol WPLS, 18 decimals. Deposit credits
the caller's WPLS balance by the native value deposited. Withdrawal checks the caller's WPLS balance,
subtracts the requested units, and transfers the same amount of native currency to that caller. It has no
bridge step or Ethereum-dollar redemption requirement. The historical trace supplies a successful
concrete withdrawal in addition to this source-defined behavior.
One raw WPLS unit corresponds to one native PLS wei in these deposit/withdraw operations. Gas and the
caller's ability to receive the native payment remain execution considerations. A claim about WPLS
equivalence should not silently include transaction fees or guarantee that every receiving contract
accepts a native transfer.
WPLS runtime bytes match between the observed trade block and the audit endpoint (2,058 bytes), as
do the pool runtime bytes (11,357 bytes). The explorer provides verified source; this study did not
independently recompile either contract. The WPLS source's bare receive function can accept native
donations without crediting a depositor's WPLS account. Its totalSupply getter reports native contract
balance. That getter alone should therefore not be used as a census of all holders' spendable balances.
What the endpoint reserves establish
At the pinned endpoint, token0 and token1 getters identify the exact copied DAI and WPLS addresses
above. The pool reports:
Pool reserve Amount
Copied DAI 18,087,077.898954788899607139
WPLS 3,443,662,680.177700347668184819
These are one pool's reported reserves at a historical fixed block, not a live quote, a network-wide
liquidity total or a promise that all that WPLS can be extracted for a finite input. The source enforces
output below the relevant reserve and an invariant. A specified-size local exit must account for input,
fees, price impact, routing, actual execution state, unwrapping and gas. This batch does not establish a
current best route or estimate a dollar price.
This local pool is separate from the earlier sampled Aave linear pools. The small waDAI linear-pool output
headroom is a limitation on that receipt-to-DAI leg, not proof that the entire local pDAI-to-WPLS market
lacks liquidity. Conversely, observing this funded exit pool does not establish funding of the proposed
source receipt or Portal leg.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 286

Governance qualifications and theory boundaries
The local exit observation does not require accepting the claimed common human ownership of bridges,
issuers or applications. The historical receipt identifies addresses and actions; it establishes neither who
owns the keys nor their plan. Existing audits establish particular Aave v2, stkAAVE, bridge ProxyAdmin
and Across control actions. They do not establish every Aave v3 role, all UMA control, Reserve voting
power or the ability to change unrelated exact-token issuer permissions. Those bounds remain as
recorded in the control studies.
For a future theoretical configuration, effective governance might change some caps, integrations or
inventory arrangements. That is different from observing that they changed. The point-12 evidence
separates three things: a real 2025 local exit branch; 2026 endpoint pool state; and a hypothetical
source-financed system that could use a compatible local exit. None is silently substituted for another.
the local-redemption definition removes any need to prove an Ethereum off-ramp for this exit; it does not
remove the need to show enough PLS for the stated quantity and price objective.
Reproduction and publication scope
New records are preserved under ignored artifacts/pulsechain-local-pls-evidence-20260929/. They include
both historical receipts/traces/blocks, endpoint and historical code reads, token identity and reserve
getters, published pair/WPLS source responses, exact reconciliation, SHA-256 manifest and a publication
file inventory. Requests retain RPC methods, parameters and block tags. Existing maintained read-only
collectors are Research/scripts/probe_pulsechain_routes.py and Research/scripts/collect_pulsechain_events.py.
A manageable publication package has two useful scopes:
Local evidence supplement: approximately 0.43 MB of raw records, or 0.07 MB compressed,
covering this local exit and wrapper/pool observations.
Reports plus selected representative evidence: approximately 1.7 MB of reports, local records,
representative ARB/GRT mint records, GRT reconciliation, withdrawal supply/coverage records, Aave
reserve observations, mathematical example and read-only collectors; approximately 0.44 MB
compressed.
Exact file paths, byte counts and hashes are in publication_inventory.json; ZIP sizes were measured using
deflate level 6. The selection is deliberately not the complete audit archive. It supports named
representative claims and does not include every source, governance record, Curve census, trace or
earlier experiment. A full reproduction of every companion claim requires its separately identified
batches. Report text and manifests are much smaller than the full raw catalogue; packaging one must
not be described as packaging the other.
The evidence depends on the selected public RPC and related explorer. Matching hashes preserve file
identity; they do not independently authenticate the node. No independent header/receipt-root
validation or second-node consensus check was performed. A publication should freeze the reports and
selected files together, state the audit endpoint and selected scope, and retain links to the precise
primary contract and transaction records. Old state and a successful historical exit remain useful
evidence without being advertised as a current quote.
Clarification: inherited WETH also wraps native PLS
A separate read-only batch addresses the additional local-exit premise. For the exact inherited WETH
contract 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2 on PulseChain, the proposed native-unit equivalence is
supported by its code:
1 inherited WETH unit ↔ 1 native PLS unit ↔ 1 canonical WPLS unit,
• 
• 
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 287

before transaction costs and subject to the relevant transfer/withdrawal calls succeeding. This is
mechanical conversion of native units, not an assertion that three different contract identities are
interchangeable inputs to a pool.
The verified inherited WETH source identifies WETH9, with symbol WETH and 18 decimals. Its deposit
credits the caller's token balance by msg.value. Its withdrawal checks and subtracts the caller's wrapped
balance and transfers the same native amount to that caller. On chain 369 the transferred native
currency is PLS. The inherited token's name “Wrapped Ether” does not make that local native payment
Ethereum ETH.
At the same audit block 27,659,393 and block hash stated above:
Observation Result
Native PLS held by inherited WETH 33,829,502,874.176104966393612215
Its reported totalSupply, in 18-decimal units 33,829,502,874.176104966393612215
Endpoint runtime size 3,124 bytes
Runtime equality with inherited block 17,232,999 Exact byte equality
The equality between native balance and reported totalSupply is expected because this WETH9
implementation defines totalSupply as its own native balance. It is not an independent enumeration of
holder balances. The read demonstrates native assets held in the wrapper; a holder still needs the
appropriate wrapped balance and a recipient capable of receiving the native transfer. This batch did not
submit or simulate a withdrawal. The source was explorer-verified rather than independently recompiled
here.
For theoretical local exits, a route paying this inherited WETH can therefore be evaluated in PLS units
through its native withdrawal mechanism; canonical WPLS has its separately verified native wrapper
mechanism. A market may still quote them differently because of execution costs, route-specific liquidity
or other constraints. Exact receiving-token addresses continue to matter.
Bridged external ETH representations are outside this equivalence. A token at another address
that represents ETH held on another chain is not established as a native PLS wrapper merely by using
the label WETH. Its own asset and redemption rules require separate evidence. This finding covers native
PLS, canonical WPLS at 0xa107…9a27, and inherited WETH at 0xc02a…6cc2 only; it does not claim every WETH
ticker on PulseChain is the same asset.
Wrapped balances and the native currency backing them are one allocation of assets. A model can
normalize these three forms into PLS units when conversion is feasible, but must not add a holder's
WETH claim and the corresponding PLS inside WETH9 as two independent spending balances. The same
qualification applies to WPLS. Native-unit convertibility does not establish a pDAI dollar price or
automatically increase the funded output inventory of a particular pool.
Fresh requests, source response, code comparisons, exact balance summary and SHA-256 manifest are
retained under artifacts/pulsechain-inherited-weth-native-20260929/. The earlier local-exit batch and its
manifests were left unchanged. Its publication inventory predates this append; a final publication should
include this fresh batch and freeze the updated report separately. No governance or permission analysis
was performed for this clarification.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 288
